## 🏭 Key Capabilities to Look For (for Warehouse, Shop-Floor & Field Teams)

When evaluating any consultant for these environments, make sure they can deliver:

| Capability | Why It Matters |
|---|---|
| **Canvas Apps** | Ideal for mobile-first warehouse/field workers on phones or tablets |
| **Model-Driven Apps** | Best for complex, data-rich shop-floor or operational management systems |
| **Microsoft Dataverse** | Provides secure, centralised data with role-based access and audit history |
| **Power Automate** | Automates workflows like shift handovers, approvals, and alerts |
| **Power BI Integration** | Turns operational data into live dashboards for managers |
| **Offline capability** | Critical for field or warehouse teams with patchy connectivity |

---

## 💡 Tips for Choosing the Right Partner

1. **Ask for industry references** — specifically from logistics, manufacturing, or field services clients.
2. **Check Microsoft Partner status** — look for certified Microsoft Solutions Partners.
3. **Request a fixed-scope proposal** — to avoid scope creep on operational app builds.
4. **Confirm post-go-live support** — shop-floor and field apps need ongoing iteration as processes evolve.
